Agent.Title: NCF Agent Workspace
Agent.Subtitle: Choose a launch target, start an isolated NCF, and watch Agent and DesktopBridge activity
Agent.ActivateWakeWordTip: Safely reinitialize wake-phrase listening for this session
Agent.RunTargetHint: Each version is an isolated Agent execution environment
Agent.ManagedHint: Installed and updated by the desktop app; good for daily use.
Agent.ManagedSharedHint: Multiple workspaces share this managed Runtime. Use different template/external workspaces when you need data isolation.
Agent.ExternalHint: Choose a publish folder or a source folder that contains Senparc.Web.csproj
Agent.ExternalWatermark: Select or paste an NCF path
Agent.RemoteHint: Connect to a deployed NCF. Remote URLs require HTTPS; localhost or local SSH tunnels may use HTTP.
Agent.TokenWatermark: Existing token (optional; leave empty to request admin pairing)
Agent.TokenHint: Recommended: leave empty. The desktop shows a pairing code for an AdminOnly admin to approve a 24-hour session. NCF_DESKTOP_BRIDGE_TOKEN still works for automation.
Agent.ChatSubtitle: Admin API stores messages; EventBus only sends authorized change notifications
Agent.AdminLoginHint: AdminOnly accounts only. Passwords and JWTs are never saved to local settings.
Agent.NewSessionPlaceholder: A new session is created on first send
Agent.ModuleHint: Checked modules can be applied to the current session and are reused for new sessions.
Agent.NoModules: This site returned no selectable modules.
Agent.SpeakTip: Read this AI reply aloud; click again to stop
Agent.ChatWatermark: Type a message; Ctrl/⌘+Enter to send, Enter for a new line
Agent.ChatSendTip: Ctrl+Enter or ⌘+Enter to send; Enter for a new line
Agent.ManagedValidation: The desktop app will manage installation and updates for this Runtime.
Settings.Title: Workspace settings
Settings.Subtitle: Configure workspace, voice models, desktop pets, and managed Runtime by category. Changes apply immediately.
Settings.LaunchConfigHint: Locked while the target is running; new values apply on the next start.
Settings.PreferencesHint: Reduce repetitive actions and control how detailed the run log is.
Settings.AutoOpenBrowser: Automatically open the embedded site when ready
Settings.ShowDetailedInfo: Show detailed download and startup logs
Settings.UiLanguageHint: Takes effect immediately; no restart required.
Settings.LocalVoiceHint: Models load only on this machine. After transcription, text is written to the AdminChat box and can be confirmed or auto-sent.
Settings.SttAutoSend: Auto-send manually started speech after STT
Settings.SttAutoSendTip: Wake-phrase recordings are sent automatically after speech end is detected. This option only controls speech started with the microphone button.
Settings.WakeWordHint: Listens only when AdminChat, Whisper, and the wake model are ready; turning off releases the microphone immediately. Listening audio is not saved or uploaded. Recording and transcription pause listening; it remains active during TTS, and a wake phrase stops TTS before recording starts. Pause briefly after the wake phrase before speaking the command.
Settings.WakeWordsTitle: Custom wake phrases and Chat actions
Settings.WakeWordsHint: Chinese-only phrases generate pinyin automatically. Use refresh to regenerate it or the symbol panel to correct a tone. An invalid entry is skipped without affecting other wake phrases. Each phrase can target an existing Chat; if it no longer exists, the current Chat is used.
Settings.WakeAutoPinyinTip: Generate tone-marked pinyin from the Chinese phrase
Settings.WakeToneSymbolsTip: Insert a pinyin tone symbol at the cursor
Settings.LocalTtsHint: Kokoro synthesizes AI speech on this machine; reply text and audio are never uploaded. Sizes are package estimates.
Settings.RobotLayoutHint: This preference applies to all workspaces and can be changed anytime without stopping NCF.
Settings.FreeFloatingHint: One pet per workspace. Drag, hover for details, and double-click for voice.
Settings.GroupedListHint: Collect pets into one always-on-top list that still shows name, pet, status, details, connection, and actions.
Settings.DesktopRobotHint: Control floating-window visibility and size. Scaling changes display size only, not animation refresh rate.
Settings.WheelZoom: Allow mouse wheel resize when the pointer is over the pet
Settings.ScaleHint: Size and wheel settings apply to free-floating mode; the unified list uses a fixed compact size. 1.0× is the minimum; the maximum can be up to 4.0×.
Settings.ManagedRuntimeHint: Affects only the managed version downloaded and maintained by the desktop app.
Settings.AboutHint: View the current version including the build number, and check for updates.
Settings.AboutFooter: On startup and every hour the app checks NCF website release info first; if unavailable it falls back to GitHub. The download link always opens https://www.ncf.pub/Download.
Settings.SavedHint: Settings are stored in the desktop app config folder.
Settings.UpdateStatusDefault: The app checks automatically on startup and hourly from the NCF website.
Template.Title: Create workspace from official template
Template.Subtitle: After creation, switch automatically to the new external source target.
Template.Intro: The desktop app installs the latest Senparc.NCF.Template online, then creates a source folder without running dotnet restore. Existing non-empty folders are never overwritten.
Template.CopyManaged: Copy config from current managed version
Template.CopyOther: Copy config from another NCF workspace
Template.SourceWatermark: NCF publish folder or source workspace
Template.ConfigCopyHint: Copies appsettings.json, App_Data/Database/SenparcConfig.config, and web.config when present. Config may contain connection strings or secrets.
Template.StatusDefault: Create from the latest Senparc.NCF.Template on NuGet.org without automatic restore.
Robot.GroupSubtitle: Drag the header to move · Double-click a pet for voice input

Robot.RowTip: Double-click to start or stop AdminChat voice input for this workspace
Robot.VoiceTip: Start or stop AdminChat voice input
Robot.MascotTip: Double-click to start or stop AdminChat voice input; enable wheel zoom in Settings
